description:
Use this when the user wants to know which social accounts are connected to RipClip (TikTok, YouTube,
        Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky; X is coming soon) or needs an account_id: "where can I post", "which accounts are
        linked". Returns each account's account_id, platform, name, username and status. draft_post, plan_posts and
        update_draft take account_id when the user has several accounts on one platform. The note says which platforms
        RipClip can post to yet (YouTube Shorts and TikTok now; Instagram, Facebook and Threads once Meta approves);
        connect_more is the page where the user connects another account, which this tool cannot do.
        Not for: post numbers (get_post_stats) or follower counts (get_account_stats). Free and read only.
name: list_social_accounts
title: List social accounts
